question1.title: What is a campaign?
question1.content: Advertising platforms are structured into three levels: campaigns, audiences, and ads. Each campaign responds to a business objective and sales funnel stage, and may include multiple audiences and ads. Your campaign structure will be tailored based on your business objectives and resources, focusing on maximizing sales and return on investment.

question2.title: How many campaigns does my business need?
question2.content: We understand that every organization is unique, with specific goals, processes, and resources, requiring a customized campaign structure. Contact us to receive a free audit and determine the ideal package for your business.

question3.title: What does the service include?
question3.content:
✅ Full management of advertising campaigns: strategy creation, ad design, execution, monitoring, data analysis, optimization, and real-time reporting platforms.

❌ It does not include: advertising investment, fees for influencers/ambassadors, audiovisual productions, website design, mailing platforms, or CRM tools.

question4.title: Is there a results guarantee?
question4.content:
We do not offer guarantees because results depend not only on ads but also on external factors within your brand ecosystem, such as your social media content, customer service, product/service quality, and customer reviews.
<italic>If an agency promises you guaranteed results, be cautious.</italic>.
At Kliv, we are transparent from the start: we audit your company, analyze its potential, and propose a campaign plan that maximizes opportunities, setting clear expectations. If we determine that your business is not ready to achieve profitable results through our services, we will let you know with total honesty.

question5.title: Do you offer services beyond advertising?
question5.content:
We specialize exclusively in what we do best: digital advertising under the performance marketing philosophy.
 Focusing on our expertise allows us to deliver exceptional results.
If you need services such as branding, website development, or social media content management, we have a trusted partner agency we’ll be happy to refer you to.

question6.title: How are you different from other agencies?
question6.content:
We are a boutique agency exclusively specialized in performance marketing.
We work with a limited number of companies per month to guarantee close, high-quality support.
Our focus is on scaling sales and maximizing advertising ROI with personalized, data-driven strategies — avoiding vanity metrics like likes, followers, or traffic.
Our method is backed by over 10 years of experience and 80+ companies served.

question7.title: What payment methods do you accept?
question7.content:
We require 100% upfront payment to start the project.Subsequent monthly payments must be made within the first 10 calendar days of each month.
We accept:

- Bank transfer within Argentina (ARS, invoice type C).
- Bank transfer to a U.S. bank account (USD, LLC invoice).
- Binance Pay (USDT).

question8.title: What is the contract term?
question8.content:
The minimum contract period is 4 consecutive months — the approximate time needed to start generating profitable results.
After that, the contract automatically renews month-to-month until either party decides to terminate, with at least 15 days' notice before the current billing cycle ends.

question9.title: When can I start?
question9.content:
First, you’ll need to complete an audit form.
If we determine your business is compatible with our services, we’ll offer you a customized proposal that fits your goals and resources.

However, spots are limited:
We can only accept 3 companies per month to maintain the quality of our services.
If no spots are available, we’ll reserve your place for the following month.

thankYou.aboutUsText: We are Agustín (strategy) and Gonzalo (operations), founders of Kliv and passionate about performance marketing. Together with a great multidisciplinary team, we’ve spent the last 11 years helping over 80 companies across several countries scale their sales. Over time, we have perfected our performance-based methodology through experience across a wide range of industries. We are passionate about what we do — and how we do it.
